name: Satellite Cannon
extDescription: This card cannot be destroyed by battle with a Level 7 or lower monster. During each of your End Phases, this card gains 1000 ATK. If this card attacks, its ATK is returned to 0, after damage calculation.

name: Book of Moon
extDescription: Flip 1 face-up monster on the field into face-down Defense Position.

name: Metamorphosis
extDescription: Tribute 1 monster. Special Summon 1 Fusion Monster from your Fusion Deck with the same Level as the Tributed monster.

name: Sakuretsu Armor
extDescription: Activate only when your opponent declares an attack. Destroy the attacking monster.

name: Night Assailant
extDescription: FLIP: Select 1 monster on your opponent's side of the field and destroy it. When this card is sent directly from your hand to the Graveyard, return 1 Flip Effect Monster from your Graveyard to your hand.

name: Big Shield Gardna
extDescription: Negate the activation of a Spell Card that designates this 1 face-down monster. At that time, flip this card into face-up Defense Position. If this card is attacked, change it to Attack Position at the end of the Damage Step.

name: Limiter Removal
extDescription: Double the ATK of all face-up Machine-Type monsters on your side of the field, until the end of this turn. During the End Phase, destroy all monsters that were affected by this effect.

name: Solemn Judgment
extDescription: Pay half your Life Points. Negate the activation of a Spell / Trap Card / Normal Summon / Flip Summon / Special Summon and destroy the Spell Card, Trap Card, or Summoned monster.

name: Reflect Bounder
extDescription: When this face-up Attack Position card is attacked by an opponent's monster, before damage calculation, this card inflicts damage to your opponent equal to the ATK of the attacking monster. Then, after damage calculation is resolved, this card is destroyed.

name: Enemy Controller
extDescription:
Select and activate 1 of these effects:
• Change the battle position of 1 face-up monster on your opponent's side of the field.
• Tribute 1 monster. Select 1 face-up monster on your opponent's side of the field. Take control of the selected card until the end of this turn.

name: Pot of Avarice
extDescription: Select 5 Monster Cards from your Graveyard, then add them to your Deck and shuffle it. After that, draw 2 cards.

name: Thunder Kid
extDescription: This monster stores electricity within his body, and can unleash it with catastrophic power.

name: Mysterious Guard
extDescription: FLIP: Return 1 face-up monster on the field to the top of its owner's Deck. Also, if there is a face-up Warrior-Type monster on your side of the field, you can return another face-up monster to its owner's hand.

name: King Tiger Wanghu
extDescription: Destroy all monsters with an ATK of 1400 or less that are Normal Summoned or Special Summoned.

name: My Body as a Shield
extDescription: When your opponent activates a card that has an effect which destroys 1 or more monster(s) on the field, pay 1500 Life Points to negate the activation of that card and destroy it.

name: Final Countdown
extDescription: Pay 2000 Life Points. After 20 turns have passed (counting the turn you activate this card as the 1st turn), you win the Duel.

name: Mudora
extDescription: This card gains 200 ATK for every Fairy-Type monster in your Graveyard.

name: Stealth Bird
extDescription: Once per turn, during your Main Phase, you can flip this card into face-down Defense Position. When this card is Flip Summoned, inflict 1000 damage to your opponent.

name: Emissary of the Afterlife
extDescription: When this card is sent from the field to the Graveyard, each player selects 1 Level 3 or lower Normal Monster from their Deck, and adds it to their hand after showing it to the opponent. The Decks are then shuffled.

name: Threatening Roar
extDescription: Your opponent cannot declare an attack this turn.
